import type { FooterContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Footer extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        serviceLogo: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        contacts: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        utilityLinks: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        privacyPolicy: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        policyLinks: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        copyrightText: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        institution: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    serviceLogo: FooterContract['serviceLogo'];
    contacts: FooterContract['contacts'];
    utilityLinks: FooterContract['utilityLinks'];
    privacyPolicy: FooterContract['privacyPolicy'];
    policyLinks: FooterContract['policyLinks'];
    copyrightText: string;
    institution: FooterContract['institution'];
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
